description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by disc-0014. An item in two clusters appears once, under its PRIMARY (first-listed) cluster; /llms.txt opens with the H1 and then the provenance comment (a profile of llms.txt v2); /llms-full.txt repeats /llms.txt through the section blocks and then, per item in the same order, one three-part block: the H2 title, the agsc:item comment, and the body fenced as text agsc-content, blocks separated by exactly one blank line. The provenance header of both files carries the AI-assistance statement of AGSC-06-15 as its last line, a constant of the specification and never authored (AGSC-06-13a as amended at rc.6). Expected bytes re-derived by hand: one further `name: value` line before the closing `-->` of each header, and nothing else moves.
